contract.deliverable: Add a nullable `display_name` column to users through a forward-only migration and backfill existing rows
acceptance: The migration applies cleanly to a database with existing users
users.display_name is populated for every existing user

managerSetup: open an FMECA session and record the backfill failure modes before editing
expected.rationale: A forward-only data migration has irreversible failure modes, so a risk pass must precede the change
